title: Serre's criterion for affineness
statement:
Let $X$ be a scheme. Assume that $X$ is quasi-compact, that $X$ is
quasi-separated, and that $\mathrm H^1(X,\mathcal I)=0$ for every
quasi-coherent sheaf of ideals $\mathcal I\subset\mathcal O_X$ of
finite type. Then $X$ is affine.
(*Stacks Project, Cohomology of Schemes, Lemma 30.3.2, Tag
[01XG](https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/01XG).*)
blueprint_proof_text: This is the recorded classical input named in the statement, Stacks Project, Cohomology of Schemes, Lemma 30.3.2 ([Tag 01XG](https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/01XG)): Serre's criterion, that a quasi-compact quasi-separated scheme is affine as soon as the first cohomology of every quasi-coherent sheaf of finite type ideals vanishes. No separate proof is given.
